title: Nitazoxanide and Umbelliferone improves Imiquimod-induced psoriasis in Balb/C mice.
authors: Purewal, Japneet Singh; Borkar, Maheshkumar; Doshi, Gaurav M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物对银屑病小鼠模型的疗效，仅涉及STAT3蛋白的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Signal Transducer and Activator of Transcription (STAT) 3 is a significant contributor to the development and pathogenesis of psoriasis (Pso). Research demonstrated STAT3 signalling to be upregulated in Pso. Additionally, Pso results in oxidative stress that activates various signalling pathways like factor nuclear kappa-B (NF-kappaB). Nitazoxanide (NTZ) is an antiprotozoal drug shown to inhibit the STAT3 pathway. Umbelliferone (UMB) is an antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory and can suppress NF-kappaB signalling. Therefore, we propose to hypothesize that NTZ and UMB would be effective in treating Pso. Balb/c mice were treated with IMQ to induce Pso. The clinical characteristics of Pso were assessed using the Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI), back skin thickness, spleen length and mass, and histology of the skin sample tissue. In addition, we measured the levels of interleukin-17 (IL-17), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), STAT3, and NF-kappaB. Furthermore, to gain the interaction of NTZ and UMB with STAT3, a detailed in-silico study has been performed. The impact of treatment on oxidative stress was evaluated by estimating the activity of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and catalase (CAT). The results demonstrate that mice subjected to IMQ-induced Pso exhibited positive responses to treatment with NTZ and UMB. Additionally, IL-17, TNF-alpha levels, STAT3, and NF-kappaB were decreased in NTZ and UMB-treated groups. SOD and CAT levels in NTZ and UMB groups were elevated. Our findings show that NTZ and UMB are potential therapeutic medications for Pso.
abstract_zh: 信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）是银屑病（Pso）发生发展及发病机制中的重要因素。研究表明，STAT3信号在Pso中表达上调。此外，Pso导致氧化应激，激活多种信号通路，如核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）。硝唑尼特（NTZ）是一种抗原虫药物，已显示可抑制STAT3通路。伞形花内酯（UMB）具有抗氧化和抗炎作用，并能抑制NF-kappaB信号。因此，我们提出假设，NTZ和UMB可能有效治疗Pso。Balb/c小鼠经IMQ处理以诱导Pso。通过银屑病面积和严重程度指数（PASI）、背部皮肤厚度、脾脏长度和质量以及皮肤样本组织学评估Pso的临床特征。此外，我们测量了白细胞介素-17（IL-17）、肿瘤坏死因子-alpha（TNF-alpha）、STAT3和NF-kappaB的水平。进一步地，为探究NTZ和UMB与STAT3的相互作用，进行了详细的计算机模拟研究。通过估算超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和过氧化氢酶（CAT）的活性来评估治疗对氧化应激的影响。结果表明，经IMQ诱导的Pso小鼠对NTZ和UMB治疗表现出积极反应。此外，NTZ和UMB治疗组中IL-17、TNF-alpha水平、STAT3和NF-kappaB均降低。NTZ和UMB组中SOD和CAT水平升高。我们的研究结果表明，NTZ和UMB是治疗Pso的潜在药物。
